item.title: "I definitely have big boots to fill with those girls that have gone before me as captain"
item.description: She has played alongside some notable figures during her time as part of the panel, but now Niamh Gallogly has been charged with leading Meath into battle for the 2026 inter-county season.

item.title: Allianz FL Division 4 clash between Waterford and Longford postponed
item.description: This afternoon's Allianz Football League Division 4 opener between Waterford and Longford has been postponed due to an unplayable pitch at Fraher Field.

item.title: Brady confirmed as Cavan captain for 2026
item.description: Ciaran Brady has been named as Cavan's new senior football captain for the 2026 season.

item.title: Ladies: Lucey and O'Connell goals steer Kerry past Dublin in Lidl NFL Division 1 opener
item.description: Jadyn Lucey and Mary O'Connell struck crucial goals at a rain-soaked JYSK Park in Clondalkin on Saturday afternoon as title holders Kerry kick-started their Lidl National Football League Division 1 campaign with victory over All-Ireland SFC champions Dublin.

item.title: Fanning's goal at the death sees Wexford snatch victory from Antrim in Division 1B opener
item.description: Mark Fanning rocketed in a 20-metre free in the seventh minute of injury-time as Wexford snatched victory from the jaws of defeat against a spirited Antrim side this afternoon in Division 1B of the Allianz Hurling League.

item.title: Royals off to a flyer as they hand Derry defeat in Division 2 opener at Croker
item.description: Meath got their Allianz Football League Division 2 campaign off to the perfect start with a 0-19 to 1-13 victory over Derry at a wet Croke Park this afternoon.

item.title: Tyrone held by 14-man Kildare on opening day as Down see off Clare
item.description: Brian McLoughlin's late two-pointer saw Tyrone and Kildare play out a 2-16 to 1-19 draw at a wet and windy Healy Park this evening.

item.title: Watch: Stakelum goal propels Tipp to victory over Galway in Division 1A opener
item.description: Tipperary got up and running in Division 1A of the Allianz Hurling League with a 1-21 to 1-16 win against Galway at rain-soaked FBD Semple Stadium this evening.

item.title: Watch: Malone goal the difference as Donegal inflict Dubs with opening league defeat
item.description: Shea Malone's goal in the run up to half-time proved the difference as Donegal defeated Dublin on a 1-20 to 0-20 scoreline at Croke Park this evening to get off to a winning start in Division 1 of the Allianz Football League.
